name: hud_line_clip_clip_segment_to_current_x_bounds
description: HudLineClip::ClipSegmentToCurrentXBounds clips a 2D segment against the current X bounds, setting endpoint clipped flags and rejecting wholly outside segments.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4bd880 calls HudLineClip::ClipEndpointToX for outside endpoints, sets the corresponding clipped flag, returns 0 with both flags set when both endpoints are outside the same X side, and returns 1 otherwise; HLIL has only expected verbose x87 status-word comparisons.
The native line-clip smoke verifies same-side right rejection and a visible left-bound clip with the expected interpolated endpoint and clipped flag.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x4bd880 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
